name: ovos-skill-goodnight
description: An OpenVoiceOS skill that connects to Home Assistant and controls a "daytime mode" input_boolean when you tell it good morning or good night
author: trueflint

setup_notes.heading: Installation
setup_notes.content:
pip install ovos-skill-goodnight

Or via `ovos-pip`:

ovos-pip install ovos-skill-goodnight

setup_notes.heading: Configuration
setup_notes.content:
Edit your skill settings file (typically `~/.config/mycroft/skills/ovos-skill-goodnight.tjlee/settings.json`) and set the following:

{
    "hass_url": "http://homeassistant.local:8123",
    "hass_api_token": "your-long-lived-access-token",
    "hass_entity_id": "input_boolean.daytime_mode"
}

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `hass_url` | `http://homeassistant.local:8123` | Base URL of your Home Assistant instance |
| `hass_api_token` | *(required)* | Long-lived access token from your HA profile |
| `hass_entity_id` | `input_boolean.daytime_mode` | The `input_boolean` entity to control |

### Getting a Home Assistant Token

1. In Home Assistant, go to your profile (bottom-left avatar)
2. Scroll to **Long-Lived Access Tokens**
